# Build Guide: Small firearms with critical strikes, stealth and cripple

![Build Guide: Small Firearms with Critical Hits, Sneak and Cripple](/uploads/563_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**Play Style:** Human | V.A.T.S. | Critical Hits | crippling | High DPS | Bloodstained | Full life

With the update on September 2nd, 2025, the perk cards are finally mostly final, so that I can now present more build guides again without them becoming obsolete after 3 months. The main focus was on being able to play significantly more different weapons with one build.

This build plays **Bloodstained** as a **Human**, but is also playable with **full health** or as a **Ghoul** with small modifications. The primary weapons are small firearms (these are **rifles**, **pistols** and also **shotguns**). Heavy weapons are also possible in principle, but with an optimized build there are other options that this build does not include. As a bonus for more damage, the build uses **Sneak**, **Critical Hit** and **Cripple**. What's new here is the cripple, which gives us another bonus of up to 345%. This means the build can be played well with or without sneaking, meaning it can also be used in events or daily operations. With Sneak (+2x) you now get a decent bonus from Covert Operations (+50%), Sandman (+100%), Aftermath (+40%) and Silencer (+50%) and take less damage.

*Full Life & Ghoul: Leave out Nerdwut perk, Bloodstained against e.g. Aristocrat or double shot swap, armor e.g. Vanguard instead of unyielding.*

## Weapons

Any rifle or pistol can be used as a weapon. Shotguns are also possible, as these are also considered “small weapons”. In this guide, I'm primarily using an assault rifle because it's currently one of the most powerful automatic rifles in Fallout 76. But I also play single shot rifles e.g. the underlever and the hunting rifle. The options are now more variable than with the old perk cards.

![Bloodstained Assault Rifle with Bully's Mod](/uploads/skywalka55-fallout76-20250918-18-47-47-build-assault-rifle.jpg) 

![Bloodstained Hunting Rifle with Bully's Mod](/uploads/skywalka55-fallout76-20250918-18-49-17-build-rifle.jpg) 

![Bloodstained Underlever Rifle with Bully's Mod](/uploads/skywalka55-fallout76-20250918-18-47-57-build-rifle.jpg) 

The legendary mods on these rifles are almost always the same:

1. **Bloodstained** (up to 130% bonus damage at 5% HP)
2. **Explosive** (+20% bonus damage + demolition expert)
3. **Optimized VATS** (-35% action point costs in VATS)
4. **The Bully** (+25% damage per crippled body part of target)*Note: For most enemies this means +150% bonus damage to head, torso, arms, legs. Some enemies have fewer (EN-06) or more "body parts" (Ultracite Horror), the damage then scales accordingly.*

I also tested Vital (+50% damage on critical hits), but Explo usually did better. At short distances, if you want to remain undetected (e.g. in West-Tek), a vital mod instead of explosive can of course make sense. Just test it out for yourself. I currently like the Explo version best.

## Armor

As armor I use Secret Service armor with the mods:

1. Unyielding
2. Powered (3x); Poisoner's (1x), Fireproof (1x)
3. Thru Hikers
4. The Ranger (2x)
Cross-border (3x)

With this combination the build achieves good SPECIAL values, has good AP acceleration, reduces the weight of chems & food/drinks, increases ranged damage and achieves more critical hits.
